1.t: The Day I Got A Little Sister
1.o: Thanks to his father's sudden remarriage, Toujou Basara finds himself with two beautiful new step-sisters. Their names are Naruse Mio and Maria. Mio wakes him up in the morning, while Maria stands in the kitchen wearing a suggestive outfit...

2.t: First Contract Between Servant And Master
2.o: As daughter of the former demon lord, Mio's foster parents were slain by powerful demons after her life. Still seeking to slay her, Basara reveals himself as a member of the hero clan--an enemy of the demons--and vows to protect Mio as a member of his family.

3.t: Reunion and a Gap in Trust
3.o: Basara's childhood friend Nonaka Yuuki warns him not to get involved with Naruse Mio any longer. She is a fellow member of the hero clan, and the one charged with observing Mio. She claims that Mio will bring great disaster, but Basara proclaims that he will protect Mio as a girl on his own.

4.o: Basara suffers a deep wound in the battle against the white-masked man after Mio's power. Mio regrets getting Basara involved, and challenges the white-masked man to battle on her own. Meanwhile, in order to protect Mio, Basara resolves to use the "forbbiden art" he sealed away after the events of his past. What was the tragedy that visited the hero village and Basara?

5.t: A Little Sister's Morning Demon Lording
5.o: With the battle against the white-masked man settled, they returned to their bawdy daily life. Basara wakes up with his hand groping Maria's butt, he runs into a naked Mio when he enters the bathroom, and Yuki sneaks into the bath with him. The master-servant pact lying at the heart of everything. Accoring to Takigawa, his classmate and the white-masked man, the pact between Basara and Mio holds another secret. Meanwhile, Basara's childhood friend Yuki invites him out on a date...

6.o: Basara goes on a date with Yuki. Unaccustomed to the shopping center, when the two of them are overwhelmed by a clerk's sales talk, Mio stops following to rescue them.

7.t: The Depths of Love and Hatred
7.o: Basara leads Mio to higher peaks as he pursues pleasure with the use of syrup. With their master-servant pact reaching a new level, they both bring their full might to face the ones trying to eliminate Mio: Takashi and Kurumi.

8.o: Ten days pass since the battle with Takashi and others. Although the battle ended with reconciliation, Yuki returned to the hero's village. ...or she was supposed to, but when Basara returns home, he finds Yuki in an apron!

9.t: Merits and Demerits of Master and Servant
9.o: Basara and Yuki begin the ceremony to form their pact. Clad in a bustier and garter belt, Yuki was raring to go for it, but she refused to forge the pact normally, and suffered the same succubus curse as Mio.

10.o: Mio has been captured by Zolgia following Maria's betrayal. Basara too is captured by Lars and brought to Zolgia's mansion. Lars' goal is to exchange Basara for Mio. He explains that he's only doing his duty as Mio's observer, but negotiations fail, and Zest slays him.

11.o: Strength as a human, the power to rend evil--With the power inherited from his father, Tojou Jin, Basara faces off against Zolgia. Basara is driven by the desire to protect his precious family. That desire gives him strength, and even as Zolgia pushes him to the edge, he rises without breaking. However, even Basara eventually runs out of strength facting that all too powerful might. His mind in despair, he's unable to escape from Zolgia's dominion...

12.o: Everyone is trapped inside the body of the demon realm's most dangerous creature, a beast capable of infinitely multiplying until it swallows the entire world. Dimensionally cut off, the only remaining option for Basara and the others is to completely eliminate this dangerous creature's vital core.

1.o: On a unique planet, a unique species takes its first steps: Mankind begins. But it's a world full of danger.

2.o: A mysterious band of pirates plunders the Mediterranean coast - leaving destruction in its wake. Empires fall, but out of the chaos, we discover iron. Armed with this wonder metal, ordinary folk can overthrow tyrants and build a new world order.

3.o: The crucifixion of Jesus gives birth to global religion, but Christianity may never have happened without the Roman Empire: the Roman Empire's vast network of roads and shipping lanes allows goods and ideas to flow across three continents, allowing Jesus' message to transform Mankind around the world.

4.o: When Rome is sacked by barbarians, Europe enters a Dark Age. But from the fringes of the old empire, two new forces remake the world. The Arabs, funded by a gold rush, unite under the banner of Islam.

5.o: Genghis Khan, the bloodiest warlord in history, sweeps south from Mongolia into China and creates a mighty empire. He leaves 40 million dead bodies in his wake. But a greater killer stalks Mankind - the Plague.

6.o: Gold from Africa kickstarts the rebirth of Europe. Money flows into Venice, creating new opportunities for entrepreneurs willing to take risks. In China, a new weapon, the gun, allows a peasant uprising to unify the country.

7.o: The Aztecs have built a mighty empire that dominates Central America. But it will be destroyed because of a domino effect. 7,000 miles away in modern-day Turkey, the great trading center of Constantinople is overrun by an Islamic army.

8.o: In the Andes, the Spanish open up the largest silver mine in the world and mint millions of pesos de ocho (pieces of eight). These coins transform the global economy. They fill the treasure chests of pirates.

9.o: Mankind embarks on a new age of exploration and tames the wilderness. In North America, Siberia and Australia ancient traditions are swept away in the name of commerce and science.

10.o: Two great revolutions entwine. The American Revolution inspires dreams of political and personal liberty. The Industrial Revolution replaces muscle power with machines, freeing Mankind from nature's limits.

11.o: The end of the Civil War allows Mankind to go into overdrive. This is an age of innovation, transformation and mass production. People believe that `Anything, everything, is possible.

12.o: Mankind takes on godlike powers: to feed billions of people, reshape the landscape, re-engineer the human body. The greatest power of all was unleashed over Hiroshima on August 6, 1945.

1.o: تبدأ شركة ألعاب صغيرة في مدينة "سينسيناتي" أكبر مشروع ترخيص في حياتها على الإطلاق... وهو ما يعلن عن ميلاد أكثر سلسلة ألعاب مربحة في التاريخ.

2.o: أشعل أحد مؤسّسي شركة "ماتيل" للألعاب ثورة أبدية في صناعة دمى الفتيات الصغيرة، مستمدًا الإلهام من دمية "ريسكي" الألمانية.

3.o: يناقش المبدعون المسؤولون عن إحياء خط الإنتاج لمصنع ألعاب "أكشن فيغر" النهضة والانهيار الملحمي لإمبراطوريتهم التي تقدر بمليار دولار.

4.o: نظرًا لحيازهم على امتياز صكّ مصطلح "أكشن فيغر" منذ أكثر من 50 عامًا، وضعت مجموعة من مسوقي الدمى رؤية لنوعية جديدة من دمى الفتيان.

1.o: بعد سنين من سوء إدارة العلامة التجارية وتباين مستوى المنتجات، يتعيّن على شركة لعب فضاء محبوبة تخطي مشاكلها السابقة في هذه الصناعة التنافسية.

2.o: قدمت "هاسبرو" منتجًا غيّر صناعة الألعاب للأبد، وذلك بالجمع بين لعب يابانية مبتكرة وخلفية درامية بارعة كتبتها شركة "مارفل كوميكس".

3.o: على الرغم من بدايتها المتواضعة في الريف الدنماركي، أصبحت شركة صنع اللبنات البلاستيكية المتشابكة هذه أكبر مصنع ألعاب في العالم.

4.o: تحت شعار "هدية صغيرة، ابتسامة كبيرة" كسياسة للشركة، نجح "شينتارو تسوجي" مؤسس "سانريو" في تحويل هرة "كاواي" إلى ظاهرة عالمية.

1.o: يجد فنانا قصص مصوّرة غير معروفَين نسبيًا فكرةً عن طريق الصدفة ستنهض بـ"جنون السلاحف"، الأمر الذي أحدث ثورة هزّت عالم صناعة الألعاب.

2.o: تتحول الرؤية الرائدة للملحن "هايم سابان"، المستوحاة من مسلسلات "سوبر سينتاي" اليابانية، إلى سلسلة ألعاب أطفال ومسلسلات تلفزيونية دامت لعقود.

3.o: تُدخِل تلك المهور الصغيرة، التي أعادت تشكيل الدمية العصرية رغم هيمنة دمى "باربي" و"بيري"، سرورًا هائلًا على الأطفال والراشدين، أو "البروني".

4.o: من "ريسيلمانيا" إلى جنون المبيعات، يتحدّث المبدعون وراء هيمنة ألعاب مصارعة المحترفين على متاجر الأطفال عن انتصاراتهم وانتكاساتهم.

1.o: In the Spring of 1905 the Schlegel family are drawn into the affairs of the Wilcox family via Helen Schlegel who has fallen for Paul Wilcox. Helen's older sister Margaret gets involved in a mix-up at a concert.

2.o: The Wilcoxes are rocked by a death in the family and the Schlegels face an uncertain future when they are evicted from their home.

3.o: Searching for a new home, Margaret receives an offer of marriage from Henry. Helen is distraught to learn that Leonard Bast is on the brink of ruin after following the advice of the Schlegels'.

4.o: Margaret is unwilling to punish Henry for his past transgressions, committed long before they met. Helen leaves for Europe without explanation, only returning when tragedy strikes.

1.o: بينما يتعرّف "ساندي" على طالبة جديدة ويوطّد علاقته بها، يؤجّل زيارة صديق قديم يرغب في رؤيته. أمّا "نورمان" فيتأقلم مع مشكلة صعبة في المنزل.

2.o: يساعد "ساندي" "نورمان" في تنظيم حدث معقّد التحضيرات، ويدعو "ليسا" لموعد غراميّ غير تقليديّ. كما يحظى "نورمان" بإعجاب الجميع في صفّ "ساندي".

3.o: بينما يُعاني "ساندي" من مشكلة غدّة البروستاتا المتدهورة والصراع القائم بين طلابه، يتولّى "نورمان" التعامل مع ابنته المضطربة "فيبي".

4.o: يلجأ "ساندي" و"نورمان" إلى بعضهما لينالا الدّعم، إذ ينتظر "ساندي" نتائج الفحوصات التي أجراها، فيما تزداد حدّة التوتّر بين "نورمان" و"فيبي".

5.o: يخشى "نورمان" من أن يكون قد اتّخذ قرارًا خاطئًا فيما يخصّ ابنته "فيبي"، ويرغب "ساندي" في توطيد علاقته بـ"ليسا".

6.o: يُقلّ "نورمان" و"ساندي" "فيبي" إلى مركز إعادة التأهيل، ثمّ يقضيان الليل في ملهًى. ويمرّ "ساندي" بضائقة ماليّة، ويعلم أنّه قد أغضب "ليسا".

7.o: يناقش "نورمان" التّرتيبات الماليّة مع "ساندي" الذي يحاول تلطيف الأجواء مع "ليسا"، وتساعد "ميندي" والدها في تسوية وضعه الضريبيّ.

8.o: يتناول "نورمان" الغداء مع صديقة "أيلين" الأرملة، ويحضر "ساندي" و"نورمان" حدث جمع تبرعات "مرضى الشلل الرعاش"، وتطارد "نورمان" سيدات من ماضيه.

1.o: تساور "ساندي" مخاوف تتعلّق بالرجل الذي تواعده "ميندي"، فيما يواعد "نورمان" حبًّا قديمًا، ويتحدّث "ساندي" إلى تلاميذه عن حقيقة حياة التمثيل.

2.t: Chapter 10. An Old Flame, an Old Wick
2.o: يزداد "نورمان" و"مادلين" قربًا بينما يقضيان بعض الوقت في "سانتا باربرا". وحين يقابل "ساندي" حبيب "ميندي"، يكتشف أمورًا كثيرة مشتركة بينهما.

3.o: تستاء "ميندي" من علاقة الصداقة المتنامية بين أبيها وحبيبها، فيما تُنهي ابنة "نورمان" فترة تأهيلها وتعود إلى المنزل أثناء زيارة "مادلين".

4.t: Chapter 12. A Libido Sits in the Fridge
4.o: تؤدي تعاملات "ساندي" مع امرأتين إلى تفكّره في شهوته الجنسيّة التي تغيّرت، فيما يُحاول "نورمان" التصالح مع "فيبي" و"مادلين".

5.o: يحثّ "ساندي" "نورمان" على القيام ببادرة كبرى من أجل "مادلين". وبعدما يمرّ "مارتن" بأزمة صحية، يقرّر "ساندي" إجراء فحص طبّي شامل.

6.t: Chapter 14. A Secret Leaks, a Teacher Speaks
6.o: رغم تشجيع "نورمان" لـ"ساندي"، يظل "ساندي" متردّدًا في مشاركة بعض الأخبار المهمّة مع "ميندي"، فيما يتوصّل "نورمان" و"مادلين" إلى اتفاق.

7.t: Chapter 15. A Hand Job Is Forgiven
7.o: يضطرّ "ساندي" للاعتراف إلى "ميندي" إثر حادثة أصابته. وبعد زيارة قبر "أيلين"، تحاول "فيبي" التصالح مع "نورمان"، ولكنّ الأمر لا يُفلح.

8.o: بينما يفكر "نورمان" في التقاعد، يأتيه زائر غير متوقع يجعله يفكر في الجانب الروحاني من حياته، ويمتعض "ساندي" من تغييرات "ميندي" في الاستوديو.

1.t: Chapter 17. In all the old familiar places
1.ar: فصل 17: في كلّ الأماكن القديمة المألوفة
1.o: بعد وفاة "نورمان"، يتشارك أحباؤه بعض الذكريات غير العادية في جنازته، ويستذكر "ساندي" الصداقة الطويلة التي جمعتهما.

2.t: Chapter 18. You only give me your funny paper
2.ar: فصل 18: إنّها مجرّد ورقة لا قيمة لها
2.o: يتلقّى "ساندي" إرثًا مفاجئًا وكمًّا هائلًا من المشاكل والمتاعب بصفته وصيًا على ممتلكات "نورمان"، وتشرع "ميندي" في رؤية "مارتن" من منظور آخر.

3.t: Chapter 19. And it's getting more and more absurd
3.ar: فصل 19: الوضع يزداد غرابة شيئًا فشيئًا
3.o: تواجه "فيبي" و"روبي" و"ميندي" ووالدتها "روز" "ساندي" بسبب غضبهم من فرض سيطرته على أموالهم، ويقع خلاف بين "ساندي" و"مارتن".

4.t: Chapter 20. The round toes, of the high shoes
4.ar: فصل 20: أوقات قيّمة لا مثيل لها
4.o: يحضر ممثّل شهير إحدى صفوف "ساندي" ويُحدث جلبةً، فيما يجد "ساندي" و"روز" نفسيهما على وفاق مع بعضهما، ويتلقّى "ساندي" عرضًا غير متوقّع.

5.t: Chapter 21. Near, far, wherever you are
5.ar: فصل 21: قريب، بعيد، أو أينما كنت
5.o: تواصل "فيبي" و"روبي" محاولات إقناع "ساندي" كي يمنحهما المزيد من أموال ميراثهما، فيما يستهلّ "ساندي" العمل على تأدية دور تمثيلي جديد.

6.o: يحتشد الجميع لحضور حفل زفاف مفعم بالمشاعر والأحاسيس. ومع مضي الوقت، تنهار المخطّطات وتتحقّق الأحلام.

1.o: Monty Don takes a grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens, from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. Monty begins his journey in Rome, power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created.

2.o: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

3.o: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

4.t: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes
4.o: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. Further north in the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.

1.o: After resigning, a secret agent finds himself trapped in a bizarre prison known only as The Village.

2.o: A new Number 8 named Nadia arrives in The Village, and together Number 6 and she plot their escape.

3.o: Number 2 believes that Number 6 resigned because he was going to sell out. Using dream manipulation, Number 2 tries to determine which one of three possible candidates Number 6 was dealing with.

4.o: Number 6 runs for the office of Number 2.

5.o: Number Six wakes up with a new identity. Now he's Number Twelve. Worse, Number Two asks him to impersonate someone--Number Six. But the new Number Six is more like him than he is.

6.o: An instant learning process becomes the Village's latest fad, but Number 6 is sure that Number 2 is using it as a brain washing tool.

7.o: Number 6 wakes up to find the Village totally deserted.

8.o: Number 6 comes across a body that has washed ashore with a radio. After sending the body back out to sea, he tries to use the radio to get rescued.

9.o: Inspired by a large chess game with people taking the place of the game pieces, Number 6 formulates a new escape plan with some compatriots.

10.o: Number 6 vows revenge and goes after a sadistic Number 2 after he drives a fellow village resident to her death.

11.o: Number Six hears of an assassination plot against Number Two, but it's the new Number Two doing all the plotting against the retiring Number Two.

12.o: After a brawl Number 6 is declared "unmutual" and is made to think that he has undergone "instant social conversion."

13.t: Do Not Forsake Me, Oh My Darling
13.o: With his mind transferred to another body, Number 6 wakes up in his London flat and can't convince his colleagues who he is. He takes off to Austria to find the one man who can help him, the person Number 2 wants him to find.

14.o: Number 6 finds himself in the middle of a wild west version of his imprisonment.

15.o: Back in London, Number 6 is trying to track down a crazed scientist who is protected by his homicidal daughter.

16.o: Because all other attempts to break Number 6 have failed, Number 2 decides to engage him in a game where one of them will end up dead.

17.o: After witnessing the trials of Number 2 and Number 48 and meeting the President of the Assembly, Number 6 escapes during the chaos that follows.

1.o: حين يُقتل ابنه في نيو أورلينز، يطلق صيدلي بحثًا لا يهدأ ووحيدًا عن القاتل، ومع تلاشي الأمل يعثر على خيط أشبه بالمعجزة.

2.o: لا تجلب محاكمة القاتل سوى عزاء بارد، ومحاولًا استئناف حياته الطبيعية، يعود الصيدلي إلى عمله ليكتشف أمرًا مقلقًا.

3.t: Dope Dealers with White Lab Coats
3.o: يكشف تحقيقه في طبيبة فاسدة بعضًا من أسوأ خطايا شركات الأدوية الكبرى، فيما تشهد البلدة ارتفاعًا مرعبًا في حالات الجرعات الزائدة.

4.o: يشكّل الدليل الدامغ الذي يملكه انفراجة في قضية كبرى لإدارة مكافحة المخدرات، لكن حل مشكلة واحدة يولّد أخرى، ومع إغلاق فصل، تمضي العائلة قدمًا.

1.o: تدور أحداث المسلسل في إطار الدراما الاجتماعية المشوقة، حيث رجل له كاريزما مختلفة تقوده بالصدفة، إلى الدخول في عالم الكبار ليبدأ في إتقانه، والتعامل معهم حتى يصبح متحكما فيه.

2.o: Carmen feels alienated from her husband, and her inability to conceive a child only complicates their relationship. Aziza gets upset when she learns her feelings for Mina aren't reciprocated, but she cannot bring herself to love Jebiro who loves her.

3.o: Carmen suspects that her husband Atef is having an affair, but she doesn't know he's cheating on her with her best friend Mirva. She asks Jebiro to take her to Umm Al-Abd for a horoscope reading.

4.o: Carmen goes to Umm Al-Abd, and she meets Mina who predicts her future. Atef runs for parliamentary elections, but as he meets Rashid, he learns it's harder than he had anticipated. Mirva asks Atef to run away with Carmen's money.

5.o: As he suspects Carmen, Atef vows revenge on Mina. He kidnaps and questions him, and falsely claims that Carmen came to him feeling devastated. Mina predicts Atef's future, and the latter sets him free.

6.o: Rashid accepts Atef's admission into the party. Carmen still has her suspicions about Mirva. Mina tells his brother he lied to Carmen and Atef about being a charlatan. Samer prepares to leave the country. Atef grows suspicious when Carmen visits Mirva's house.

7.o: Jebiro takes pictures of Carmen together with Mina. Mina confesses to Carmen that he's not a charlatan, and, driven by his hatred for Mina, Jebiro reports him to the police. When he joins the party, Atef confirms the truth of what Mina told him and releases him.

8.o: Mina learns that Jebiro has reported him. Fady stalks Sabine, and it turns out they were once in a relationship and he hurt her. Atef asks to meet Mina, and Carmen warns Mina against working with Atef.

9.o: Ziad falls ill but keeps the news from Mina. Carmen tries to locate Atef's mistress. When Carmen asks Mina to work with her, he refuses. Aziza informs Mina of Ziad's illness.

10.o: Mina accepts to work with Carmen to provide for Ziad's treatment, but the latter passes away. Fady refuses to leave Sabine, as he introduced her to the world of drugs. Atef suspects that Mazen knows about his relationship with Mirva.

11.o: Mina starts working with Carmen who throws a party and invites her friends for a fortune reading.

12.o: Carmen tries to persuade Mina that he needs to get back to work to earn money. Atef feels that his relationship with Mirva might threaten his position at the party. Sabine decides to get back with Fady.

13.o: When Atef asks Mina to tell Carmen he's not seeing other women, Mina does the opposite. Samer helps Mina get information about the businesswomen to delude them into believing he is a charlatan.

14.o: Jebiro gets money from Mirva to divulge to her Mina's location. It turns out that Atef incited Fady to ruin Sabine's life in order to seize her and her sister's property.

15.o: With Mina's help, Carmen rescues Sabine at the last minute. When Fady tells Atef that Jebiro knows their secret, Atef pays Fady off and urges him to disappear for a while.

16.o: Carmen learns that Atef is stealing from her father's company and he has created private accounts. Mirva tells Mina she's having an affair with Atef.

17.o: To get the villa, Atef lies to Sabine and tells her about Fady's plan to post the videos. Mina starts a new radio show about horoscopes and it gains wide popularity. Sabine dies in a tragic accident. Carmen leaves Atef and starts anew.

تهرب عليا ليلة عقد قرآنها رفضًا للزواج من شريف، وترفض سهير الاستماع لعليا وتقوم بحبسها في المنزل.

2.o: يمر أسبوعين، فتعود عليا للعمل وسط انتقادات من حولها، وتعثر على مسابقة هامة، فتقرر الاستقلال وترك بيت والدتها للتفرغ واستيفاء شروط المسابقة.

3.o: تصاب سهير بصدمة بعد ترك عليا للمنزل، ويذهب شريف لعليا فيلومها على ما فعلته معه.

4.o: يمنع نبيل - عليا من دخول الشركة وأداء وظيفتها، ويتقدم علي للزواج من هالة فتوافق، ويتعرض رشدي لوعكة صحية ويدخل المستشفى.

5.o: تبدأ عليا عملها في مجال توصيل الزبائن بسيارتها لتوفير النفقات، وترفض والدة علي زواجه من هالة، وتدبر سهير خطة لإعادة عليا للمنزل.

6.o: تفشل خطة سهير في إعادة عليا، وتطلب عليا من حسين توفير فرصة عمل لها في المطعم، ويقرر حسين الانفصال عن نانسي.

7.o: تبدأ عليا عملها في المطعم، وتطلب سهير العمل في المصنع محل عليا، وتكتشف عمل عليا في مطعم فتلومها وتطلب منها العودة لبيت العائلة فترفض عليا.

8.o: تكتشف عليا سرقة أعمالها الفوتوغرافية من قبل مدربتها، ويذهب علي للتقدم لهالة فتعترض سهير على فارق السن، وتذهب والدة علي لهالة في العمل فتطلب منها الابتعاد عن ابنها.

9.o: تشعر عليا بالغيرة على حسين من نانسي، ويقود عبدالحفيظ ثورة بموظفين المطعم ضد حسين فتنقذ عليا الموقف.

10.o: ناصر يورط أحمد في علاقة مع امرأة مشبوهة لابتزازه بالتنازل عن حقوقه المادية لديه، وتقرر هالة الإنفصال عن علي بسبب رفض أهلهما لزواجهما، ويطلب نبيل من إنجي إقناع سهير بالزواج منه.

11.o: تدخل عليا وآدم في صدام مع نبيل بسبب رغبتهما في تنفيذ مشروع الملابس في المصنع، وتنجح عملية رشدي، بينما تلاحظ نانسي إنجذاب حسين لعليا.

12.o: يوافق نبيل على مشروع عليا وآدم، وترفض عليا العودة للعمل وترك المسابقة، وترفض سهير الزواج من نبيل، ويقرر حسين الانفصال عن نانسي.

13.o: يعترف أحمد لإنجي بخيانته وعرضه للابتزاز من ناصر، وتذهب عليا للاعتذار لشريف عن ما فعلته في حقه فيرفض اعتذارها.

14.o: يتزوج علي من هالة متحديًا والديه، وتتطور العلاقة بين حسين وعليا، ويذهب شريف لعليا ويقبل اعتذارها.

15.o: يتصالح أحمد وإنجي، وتحكي عليا تجربتها في بث مباشر، وتكتشف اختلاق هالة لقصة المسابقة والشركة الوهمية لمساعدتها على الخروج من بيت سهير، ويقرر حسين وعليا الزواج.

1.o: تترك نسمة طفلتها لندى وتهرب خوفًا من قتلها على يد والديها، وتحاول ندى رعاية الطفلة، وتكذب ندى على حمدي والد نسمة فتُخبره بتسليمها الطفلة للشرطة.

2.o: تُسلم ندى الطفلة لدار لرعاية الأيتام، وتزداد الخلافات بين ندى وهشام، وتُخطط لتبني الطفلة الرضيعة أحلام.

3.o: تبدأ ندى خطوات تبني أحلام، ويدخل صلاح في صدام مع زوجته بعد طردها للعديد من مهندسي مشروعهما، وتفشل سالي في إقناع ندى بالعدول عن التبني.

4.o: يستقيل خالد ويعود لمصر للمكوث مع ندى بشكل مؤقت، وتُخطط ندى لتبني يونس بدلًا من أحلام، فيعترض خالد على الأمر.

5.o: ترفض الاخصائية طلب ندى بتبني يونس بعد رفض خالد للأمر، وتصارح ندى - الطفل بالأمر وتعده بحله، ويذهب سالي وراجي لطبيب نفسي بعد وفاة رضيعهما.

6.o: ينتقل يونس لمنزل ندى فتصطدم الأخيرة برفض شقيقها خالد، ويحذر خالد أبناءه من التعامل مع يونس، ويحاول راجي إقناع سالي باستكمال العلاج النفسي

7.o: يُعاني يونس بعد انتقاله لمدرسته الجديدة، ويتقرب صلاح من ندى، ويحاول خالد الحصول على عمل بمصر.

8.o: يعتدي يونس على زميله بعد تنمر الأخير عليه، ويغضب هشام من ندى بعد اكتشافه تبنيها ليونس.

9.o: يفشل يونس في التكيف مع أصدقاؤه الجدد، وتُصاب رانيا بالغيرة بعد اكتشافها علاقة صلاح وندى.

10.o: ترفض رانيا اتخاذ خطوة في علاقتها بمصطفى خوفًا من الندم، وتتوطد العلاقة بين ندى وصلاح، وتطلب سالي الطلاق من راجي.

11.o: يكتشف خالد سرقة ابنه للطلاب بالمدرسة، وتقرر بسنت ترك المنزل، وترفض سالي السماح لندى بالإصلاح بينها وبين راجي.

12.o: يصدم صلاح - ندى بتفكيره في العودة لرانيا، وتكتشف سالي حملها مجددًا، ويصطدم المزارعين برغبة خالد في طردهم من أرضه، وترفض ندى محاولات صلاح بالتواصل معها مجددًا.

13.o: تطلب نسمة من ندى مساعدتها في استعادة طفلتها أحلام، ويُخبر صلاح - رانيا برفضه فكرة عودتهما مجددًا، وتُهدد الأخيرة صلاح باستعادتها حضانة طفلتهما في حالة زواجه من ندى.

14.o: تحصل رانيا على حضانة سلمى قبل تراجعها وإعادتها لوالدها، ويهجم المزارعين على أرض خالد فيُصاب بطلق ناري بكتفه، ويختفي يونس.

15.o: تبحث ندى وصلاح عن يونس في كافة الأماكن دون جدوى، ويعود يونس لدار الأيتام ويرفض العودة مع ندى، وينجح صلاح في إقناع يونس بالعودة لمنزله، بينما يتفق مع ندى على الزواج.

1.o: تصطحب شيري - ابنها ياسين للاحتفال بعيد ميلاد والدها، وفي الطريق يتشاجر ياسين مع الطبيب البيطري كريم معتقدًا بمغازلته لشيري، ويكتشف علاقة والدته بكريم من خلال رسائل بهاتفها

2.o: يراقب ياسين - شيري أثناء مقابلتها لكريم، الذي يطلب منها إعلام أولادها بعلاقتهما ليتزوجا، ويحتدم الأمر بين شيري وياسين بعد مواجهتها بعلاقتها بكريم، وتقرر ياسمين التقدم لوظيفة مضيفة طيران لتنال حريتها.

3.o: تتشاجر شيري مع كريم لحديثها مع ياسين، وتحاول نوشكا إصلاح الأمر بين كريم وشيري، التي ترفض عرض زواجه خوفًا على أولادها.

4.o: تسعى شيري لنيل رضا ياسين، فتخبره برفضها الزواج من كريم وقطع علاقتها به.

5.o: يحاول والد شيري إقناعها بالتفكير في الزواج من كريم، ويسعى ﻹقناع ياسين بذلك، ولكن يتشاجر الأخير مع جده وشيري ويترك المنزل، بينما تتعرف درية والدة كريم على أحد الأشخاص وتتقرب له.

6.o: يتوجه ياسين لزيارة والده وائل بالإسكندرية، ويخبره بمشكلته مع والدته، فتقرر شيري الزواج من كريم، الذي ترفض أمه تلك الزيجة لكون شيري مطلقة ولديها أولاد.

7.o: يُقام حفل خطوبة كريم وشيري بالرغم من اعتراض ابنها، الذي تعامله زوجة وائل بطريقة سيئة.

8.o: يلوم محمود - أفنان على عدم حضورها خطوبة شيري وكريم، وتعترض رانيا زوجة وائل على وجود ياسين في منزلها.

9.o: يصطحب وائل - ياسين للقاهرة، ويثور ياسين عندما يعلم بخطوبة شيري وكريم، ويلتف الجميع حوله.

10.o: يحاول مروان نصح ياسين بالابتعاد عن شربيني لسوء سلوكه، وينجح الأخير في السيطرة على ياسين والتقرب له في ظل معاقبة شيري له.

11.o: يتشاجر والد شربيني مع ابنه لاستهتاره ولتناوله المخدرات، وتحاول أفنان إصلاح الأمر بين شيري وكريم، ويفصح عمر لياسمين عن حبه.

12.o: يعتذر ياسين لمروان عما بدر منه في حقه، ويقطع علاقته بشربيني، ويصلح الأمر مع شيري لاحتياجه للأموال، ويطلب منير من سعاد الزواج.

13.o: يتشاجر ياسين مع شريبني ويقعان في مشاكل مع إدارة الجامعة، ويستنجد مروان بشيري، ويستاء كريم من رد فعل ياسين معه ويلوم - شيري على طريقة تربيتها له.

14.o: يندم ياسين على ما فعله مع والدته ويضطر للعمل مؤقتًا بعد حرمانه من دخول الامتحان، ويحاول منير التحدث مع كريم بشأن موضوع زواجه من والدة كريم.

15.o: تتحسن علاقة ياسمين بوالدها، وكذلك ياسين بشيري، وتحتفل درية ومنير بخطبتهما، ويعتذر ياسين لشربيني ويخبره الأخير بسفره للسعودية مع والده، ويعود كريم لشيري.

1.o: The Kinsellas are a small but tight-knit crime family in Dublin, Ireland, increasingly at odds with a powerful drug cartel. When the hotheaded son of Frank Kinsella gets into a violent confrontation with one of Eamon's men, the Cunninghams retaliate.

2.o: The Kinsellas deal with the fallout of the Cunningham's relatiation, Frank attempts to avoid an all-out war, while Michael is torn between helping Jimmy seek his revenge and staying above the fray so he can see Anna again.

3.o: The Kinsellas bury one of their own as they prepare for an all-out war against the Cunninghams, Michael and Jimmy set a plan in motion for revenge, and Amanda orders her first hit.

4.o: The walls close in; the Kinsellas are blacklisted by Eamon Cunningham, but necessity is the mother of invention; Amanda pitches an idea to force Cunningham back onto his heels.

5.o: The Kinsellas strike back at Eamon Cunningham as Amanda starts to blame others for Jamie's death; Michael unintentionally puts Anna in danger; the endgame starts to take shape.

6.o: Frank and Eamon deal with the stress in different ways, as Amanda continues to anger the rest of the family with her dynamism.

7.o: Frank visits his brother, Bren, in jail and remembers why his brother is not a man to be trifled with; danger lurks around every corner; Amanda and Michael come to a realization.

8.o: Eamon and Amanda meet to discuss a way to end the war; the proposal does not go over well with Frank; Jimmy and Michael meet at a crossroads; the family gathers for Jamie's memorial service.

7.o: Bren's chaos reaches an apex, and the family is driven to mayhem. Michael and Viking both suffer heartbreak, while Uncle Frank seeks a change. The Batuks sew their own discord, and Amanda and Jimmy's son Anthony does the unthinkable.

8.o: The conflict is put into overdrive as Michael and Jimmy find common ground. Amanda proposes an unexpected partnership for mutual survival. Anthony and Nikita try to come to terms with the consequences of their actions.

8.o: Haya quarrels with her mother because of Saud and Rabi’a. Najiba rejoices in the arrival of Sira who will soon enough cooperate with Nadia.

21.o: Dina discovers the bitter truth and confronts Rabi’a about it. Saud is infuriated after a conversation with Ahmad.

25.o: When Saud puts Ahmad in real trouble, Umm Khaled seeks Najiba's help. Sultan's newly launched business is a success.

26.o: When Ahmad admits to what he has done, Umm Khaled makes a bold move. After Diya’ kicks her out, Umm Khaled moves to Khaled’s house.

27.o: After Umm Khaled gives Khaled a tongue-lashing, he asks her to leave the house. Abu Khaled quarrels with his sons who discover they wronged their mother.

28.o: Haya informs Ahmad about what might end her suffering and make her happy. After she has been mistreated by Nadia for so long, Bruin shows her true colours.

29.o: After Haya ignores Abdallah’s calls, he asks her to listen to what he has to say. When Bruin puts Nadia in trouble, Abu Khaled makes up his mind about his marriage.

30.o: Season Finale - Umm Khaled saves Najiba’s family. Khaled gets his revenge. After Abu Khaled suffers a health setback, he asks to see Umm Khaled.

4.o: Nadia has a promising date. Pradhyuman sees a life coach. Sima sends Aparna to an astrologer and seeks a cultural match for guidance counselor Vyasar.

5.t: Take the Elephant out of the Room
5.o: A date with a model uplifts Pradhyuman. As Aparna’s luck seems to turn, Vyasar hits a snag. Akshay’s mother insists that he marry within the year.

6.o: Vyasar and Rashi instantly bond. As Akshay rejects over 70 matches, Preeti gives him an ultimatum. Progressive Ankita looks for an equal partnership.

7.o: Sima faces a challenge with single mother Rupam. A discovery about her match bothers Ankita. Vyasar frets over revealing his father’s past to Rashi.

8.o: Akshay makes a decision while a new path emerges for Rupam. Ankita has an empowering realization. As her clients move on, Sima’s work never stops.

1.o: Sima meets Akshay, a bachelor whose small-town location has hindered his search for love. Meanwhile, some of her past clients return with new hopes.

2.t: Be a Boss, Marry a Boss, Build an Empire
2.o: Sima urges Akshay to change his thinking, and worries about Nadia and Vishal's differences. New client Viral shares her criteria for an ideal mate.

3.o: Viral and Aparna each go on first dates. Concerned that his past might hamper his future, Akshay takes action. Nadia faces a surprise in California.

4.t: I Love You Like a Friend
4.o: An old client returns — and he's not alone! Sima meets soft-spoken cardiologist Arshneel. Viral seeks a physical attraction. Aparna reflects on Daman.

5.o: A date leaves Arshneel apprehensive. Aparna reaches a conclusion about her needs. Sima and new client Shital debate compromise versus settling.

6.o: Despite a rocky date, Viral may be smitten. Arshneel and Rinkle get off to a promising start. A charming but chatty prospect gives Shital pause.

7.o: After a few flat dates, Shital worries about self-sabotage. Chemistry also proves elusive for Vinesh, Sima's new client, as he meets a potential match.

8.t: I Feel Like He's The One
8.o: Opening up to Aashay, Viral notices her softer side emerging. Still struggling to find a connection, Vinesh finally considers changing his own mindset.

1.o: In London, Priya hopes for a new start and teacher Bobby wants out of the friend zone. In New Delhi, a client returns. A happy couple ponders next steps.

2.o: Sima meets with founders of South Asian dating apps. Bobby and Priya take a salsa class. Rushali worries a spouse will separate her from her parents.

3.o: Viral meets Aashay's parents. Rushali enjoys a first date — until it hits a snag. In California, Sima urges ER doctor Vikash to rethink his criteria.

4.o: Vikash struggles to let go of his checklist. A new prospect has Priya cautiously optimistic. A life coach helps Rushali open up.

5.o: As Priya considers rejecting an effusive suitor, Sima pushes back. Arti seeks a match with ambition and an edge. A familiar face returns with a new glow.

6.o: The future looks bright for Shital and Priya. Arti begins to question Sima's outlook. Vikash and a date hit it off — but they have one big difference.

7.o: Finding a match for marketing professional Pavneet may be a tall order. Through a dating app, Arti finds the spark she's seeking — but Sima is skeptical.

8.o: Pavneet seeks clarity when a suitor is slow to follow up. Arti is in for a surprise. As for Sima? She remains in demand as ever.

1.o: تستدعي حالة طوارئ عائلية قاتلًا وحشيًا من "تايبيه" إلى "لوس أنجلوس"، في حين يقبل "بروس" المتعسّر ماديًّا بوظيفة جديدة. ويلتئم شمل أخوين بعد قطيعة بعد وقوع أزمة.

2.o: يُخبر "تشارلز" "بروس" بمجال عمله الفريد أثناء محاولته التخلص من جثة، لكنه مع ذلك لا يزال مستهدفًا للقتل أينما ذهب.

3.o: حين يختفي "بروس"، تشارك "صن" الأم و"تشارلز" في لعبة "ما جونغ" ويقومان بزيارة مطعم مأكولات بحرية بحثًا عن إجابات. ويجمع هدف مشترك طرفين متعاديين ليصبحا حليفين.

4.o: بعد تردده بشأن الانضمام إلى عمل العائلة، يتعهد "بروس" بالتركيز على الدراسة والفنّ الارتجالي، لكن حين يُثبت اجتماع لعصابة الثالوث خطورته، تضطر عائلة "صن" إلى تغيير محور اهتماماتها.

5.o: في أعقاب الهجمات، يبذل "بروس" جهده ليكون ذخرًا مفيدًا. وتستغل "صن" الأم المعلومات التي في حوزتها، بينما يستفيق "تشارلز" وهو مصاب في مكان غريب.

6.o: تسافر "صن" الأم إلى "تايوان" وتصلها أخبار مزعجة، فيما يجد الأخوان ملاذًا آمنًا لهما في منزل صيفي لأحد المشاهير. أما "بروس" و"غريس"، فتتوطّد علاقتهما معًا.

7.o: باجتماع الأشباح في "لوس أنجلوس"، تعيد العائلة تنظيم صفها، حتى يعرقل خططها وصول زائر غير متوقع. وثمة مناسبة مهمة للغاية تعمّها الفوضى.

8.o: تصبح حيوات أفراد عائلة "صن" وإرثهم في كف القدر، مع تفتّح جراح قديمة وانكشاف حقائق قاسية. ويتخذ "بروس" خيارًا قد يغيّر مصير العائلة إلى الأبد.

1.o: Gökhan receives a mysterious text from someone named Kübra that seems to predict the future, sending him into a crisis of identity and faith.

2.o: As Gülcan grieves their father's death, Gökhan faces the ultimate test from Kübra.

3.o: As Gökhan's acts mystify onlookers, the police begin to investigate him. His family grapples with their place in his new life.

4.o: Merve tries to convince Gökhan to speak to the media. As his following grows, Semavi attracts the wrong kind of attention.

5.o: As Gökhan's supporters mourn a difficult loss, tensions boil over, causing rifts in his following that lead to clashes with law enforcement.

6.o: Inspector Kara confronts Semavi over something personal. At Merve and Gökhan’s wedding, Gülcan learns a terrible secret.

7.o: Gökhan discovers the unnerving truth behind the attempt on his life. Merve faces the fallout of her actions.

8.o: Confronted with the astonishing truth behind Kübra, Gökhan must decide whether to give up on his followers or push forward.

1.o: Following a shocking feat, the government searches desperately for Gökhan and his followers. In Semavi's underground camp, cracks begin to form.

2.o: Merve learns a dangerous secret that puts everything in jeopardy. Meanwhile, Gökhan clashes with his allies about how to use their newfound influence.

3.o: Gülcan escapes with an old flame. Merve investigates a mystery of her own. Gökhan becomes increasingly isolated, even within his camp.

4.o: A raid at the camp leads to great losses. Gökhan swears revenge as he continues his search for Gülcan.

5.o: Pushed to the brink, Gökhan escalates his movement — with dangerous consequences — and a secret relationship is revealed.

6.o: An investigator goes rogue to get a hold of answers. Berk comes into contact with the people he helped indoctrinate.

7.o: With just a few faithfuls left, Berk must make one last attempt to reach his goal. But before he will play along, Gökhan wants to see his sister.

8.o: With the streets in crisis and the authorities closing in, will Gökhan finish what he started — or end it once and for all?

1.o: Blatt Meister Ascheriit was slain by his allies and was branded a traitor. Now, 20 years later, he is back with a new name, Köinzell, and a thirst for vengeance. Köinzell arrives at the border wall, Thousand Stonespears, at the Border City of Rielde-Velem. Here, he sets about infiltrating an underground monastery of corrupt monks.

2.t: Unter Morgen Monde (Under the Morning Moons)
2.o: During a deadly exchange against Rangzatz, Köinzell is thrust down to the depths of the underground monastery. However, Köinzell had visited this fortress with Ergnach in the past. And now, as Köinzell fends off the elite warrior monks, he releases the magic circle spell his comrade had once sacrificed his life to conjure.

3.o: When Köinzell reaches the Seven Heroes' encampment, he is forced to confront the immense power and glory his former comrades have amassed since they murdered him in cold blood. Despondent, Köinzell is standing in the rain when a masked avenger makes an attempt on his life.

4.o: Chiliarch Fargo invites Wied and Aht to the mayor's manor at night. That night, the two are met by a horde of undead bandits risen through dark Wischtechian magic. Simultaneously, Fargo launches a brutal assault on the refugees, including Peepi. Under the moonlit sky, Köinzell unleashes the power of his Black Sword.

5.t: Die Burg vom Helden (The Castle of the Hero)
5.o: Schtemwölech welcomes Köinzell's assault with a powerful blast from Dragon's Maw, a Wischtechian magic artillery. Köinzell diverts its attack and breaches the defenses of the castle.Inside, Geranpen is faced with the ultimate choice: either remain loyal to his Lord or seek out the truth.

6.o: In the depths of the castle altar, Schtemwölech had been conducting vile experiments on demihuman girls. By infusing fairyblood to his, the landgrave had attained a physique of steel through a Wischtechian ritual. Now, Köinzell must confront this former friend to put an end to his twisted plan.

7.o: A state funeral is held to pay tribute to Schtemwölech's glorious rule. Peepi and Altea reconvene with Köinzell, who had taken shelter in the mountains. As the company watch the funeral procession lay the landgrave's coffin to rest at the sacred burial site, Köinzell vows vengeance against the six remaining heroes.

8.o: In a fit of paranoia, the deranged Batterygrave Barestar commands his men to search for the Hero-Killer in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, where Köinzell sought shelter. Meanwhile, under Glenn's leadership, Elsaria's company hunts for the treacherous rebel.

9.o: At the Hall of Swords, Glenn entrusts a manhunt mission to Ichfeis, a slave knight vying to restore the title Blatt Meister. Meanwhile, in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, Köinzell's fight against Elsaria and company takes a desperate turn. Eager to prove herself, Aht recklessly charges in, only to sustain an injury.

10.o: Köinzell's stand against the batterygrave's military inspires the townsfolks of Jullas-Abllas to take up arms. Their bravery even convinces Elsaria, the Elector's daughter, to side with the Free City. Just as the tides are about to turn in Köinzell's favor, a powerful blast from a magic artillery cuts through the sky.

11.o: As Barestar's Floating Castle and magic artillery wreak havoc on all, the people recognize Köinzell's stand to protect the city and call him for what he is, a hero. Meanwhile, Elsaria and company thwart Barestar's men from snatching Marquis Glenn's latest Flagship of the Dragon Airship Fleet, and launch a counteroffensive.

12.o: Ichfeis, a slave knight who seeks to earn his freedom, faces Köinzell the Hero-Killer in a fated duel. As they cross blades, Ichfeis coaxes Köinzell to launch the Black Wing, the crowning technique of Ludift-style swordsmanship, and delivers his own imperfect rendition. Köinzell strikes back with a magnificent assault.

1.o: Lost luggage can't keep Conan from experiencing the best of Norway – which includes dressing like a local, Viking battles and drunk knitting.

2.o: In Buenos Aires, Conan takes on practice with a local football club, asado with Jordan Schlansky, and learns what it means to be a Gaucho.

3.o: Conan's mental and physical resolve are put to the test in Bangkok as he squares off against a Muay Thai fighter, a python and deep-fried scorpion.

4.o: While chasing his family's roots in Ireland, Conan endeavors to speak like a local, sing with The Irish Tenors, and act on a long-running soap opera.

1.o: For genius actuary Ki-jun, divorce was the worst disaster of his life. Determined to turn it into an insurance product, he forms a team with his recently divorced neighbor, Han-deul, as an underwriter, and his ex-ex-ex-wife, Na-rae, as a quant. Thus, the divorce insurance project officially begins.

2.o: The team is astonished to learn that Na-rae, who joins the task force as a special advisor quant and a senior managing director at Plus General Insurance, is also Ki-jun’s ex-ex-ex-wife, though the two seem surprisingly unfazed. As the team pairs up to gather data for the divorce insurance policy, Ki-jun takes Han-deul to an unexpected place seemingly unrelated to their research.

3.o: The team works tirelessly, fully dedicated to developing a divorce insurance policy. After much effort, the team finally secures conditional approval. But to everyone’s dismay, Ki-jun leads them to a wedding fair to meet their subscriber target. However, Han-deul suddenly cancels all sign-ups at the fair, abruptly halting the plan for reasons unknown.

4.o: When Han-deul bumps into Ki-jun, weary from a run-in with his former brother-in-law, they begin to understand each other's demons of the past. Meanwhile, Na-rae and Jeon-man click and spark a mutual attraction, and Ah-young meets dancer and farmer Woong-sik on a blind date. However, as the task force gains momentum, they face a new challenge— rising divorce rates among their clientele.

5.o: Ki-jun and Han-deul rush to resolve a complaint that their divorce insurance subscription event violates industry regulations. Meanwhile, a policyholder couple's decision to get a divorce breaches both industry regulations and company conditions. The task force scrambles to locate the couple, only to discover that the husband, who holds the key to saving the divorce insurance, is missing.

6.o: Ki-jun and Han-deul get lost searching for Hyeon-jae when a looming shadow sparks fear—could the rumored tiger be real? They find Hyeon-jae just in time and escape. Upon reuniting with the team, they notice Mi-rae has come for Hyeon-jae but keeps her distance. With village head Woong-sik’s help, they find lodging and work to mend the couple’s rift while reflecting on their past and future.

7.o: "Would you like to live at my place?" In an effort to make Han-deul feel more comfortable, Ki-jun suggests they swap homes. Thanks to his thoughtful gesture, she gradually regains her self-esteem. However, when an elderly couple files for divorce, the divorce insurance faces a new challenge, sparking a heated debate within the team over the implications of late-life divorce.

8.o: Ki-jun and Han-deul have no choice but to explain their situation when Na-rae and Jeon-man catch them living in each other's homes. Meanwhile, evidence of Young-kyu's affair comes to light, voiding his divorce insurance subscription. This development helps the project avoid another crisis. However, for some reason, Han-deul suddenly tries to dissuade Seon-hee from proceeding with her divorce.

1.o: After being shot and killed Yu Jin, Jiang Si awakens in the past and vows to change the events that not only led to her death but also her family’s. Upon re-awakening, she realizes that Yu Jin has saved her from drowning, which was instigated by her betrothed, Ji Chong Yi. She decides to do her utmost to break her engagement with Ji Chong Yi, while Yu Jin investigates her background.

2.o: Worried their reputation is at stake, her aunt and grandmother force her to accept the marriage. Despite Jiang Si refusing her betrothal to Ji Chong Yi, she takes her grievance to the higher courts. However, the witnesses she summons are paid off by Ji Chong Yi’s older brother, and Jiang Si’s case hangs on the edge. She calls her final witness, but it’s not clear what the witness will say.

3.o: Fortunately, Jiang Si is able to annul the betrothal with Ji Chong Yi. Yu Jin purchases the house alongside Jiang Si’s, looking for clues on the Saintess of Nanwu tattoo he saw at the back of her neck. Jiang Si’s second sister suddenly shows up, inviting her to visit, but Jiang Si remembers what happened with her second sister’s husband, so she refuses the invitation…until she realizes a young girl who looks like her suddenly disappears.

4.o: Jiang Zhan makes a splash after encountering Lu Chu Chu, Yu Jin’s junior sister. Jiang Si decides to visit her second sister, but takes great pains to prepare in advance of her visit. Yu Jin begins investigating the case of the missing girls in the city and chances upon Jiang Si.

5.o: Jiang Si and Yu Jin work together to get evidence of the young Marquis of Chang Xing committing crimes against kidnapped women. However, Cao Xing Xing is one step ahead of them and hides all the evidence before Yu Jin and Zhen Heng arrive. Tired of being abused, Jiang Qian decides to go back home but is disheartened when she realizes her father and grandmother intend for her to go back.

6.o: After learning from his mole that Yu Jin has secured new evidence, Cao Xing Xing turns the tables on Jiang Qian and accuses her of killing the women. Desperate, upon seeing an escaped captive come forward to be a witness against Cao Xing Xing, he tries to kill Jiang Qian but injures Yu Jin, instead. Cao Xing Xing is sent to prison to await trial.

7.o: Master Chang Xing uses his relationship with the Royal Princess to help get his son out of prison. Yu Jin finds evidence of possible collusion between the Chang Xing residence and Nanwu. Caught between justice for the dead women and the Royal Princess, Yu Jin makes a desperate attempt to get the Emperor to preside over the case.

8.o: As a child, Yu Jin was sent to the faraway borders as the astronomers predicted he was the harbinger of disaster. At Jiang Si’s urging, he decides to investigate the source of the ill prediction. Jiang Si opens up a fragrance shop. Zhen Heng’s mother looks for a marriage prospect for him and meets Jiang Si. Jiang Si’s older sister arrives for their grandmother’s birthday banquet.

9.o: At Madam Jiang’s birthday banquet, Madam Zhen expresses her interest in having her son betrothed to Jiang Si, which upsets Jiang Pei and 2nd madam. To ruin Jiang Si’s reputation, 2nd madam and Jiang Pei drug Jiang Si, who is fortunately rescued by Yu Jin. Their disappearance from the banquet causes much speculation, so Jiang Si retaliates.

10.o: Jiang Si becomes the new madam in charge of the household and deftly overcomes obstacles in her path. She helps her 2nd sister, Jiang Qian, find her freedom from the confines of her mother. Madam Zheng begins to have doubts about Jiang Si’s suitability with her son. Yu Jin continues his search for Nanwu spies.

11.o: Yu Jin continues his search for clues when Jiang Si meets with a Nightingale contact to inquire about the saintess mark. Jiang Zhan confronts a belligerent princess, causing Jiang Si to worry about his safety. Jiang Si does what she can to protect her brother, while trying to find a suitable husband for her sister, Jiang Pei. Madam Zheng uses this opportunity to further push Zhen Heng and Jiang Si together.

12.o: Upset at first with Lu Chu Chu’s relationship with Jiang Zhan, Madam Jiang is relieved to hear Chu Chu is the daughter of a famous general. Ji Chong Yi seeks the help of Princess Ming Yue to bring down Jiang Si’s fragrance shop. Yu Jin offers to be a shareholder of Jiang Si’s shop to help offset the losses incurred by Ming Yue’s minions. Jiang Si is struck with fear when Jiang Zhan goes missing.

13.o: As Jiang Si’s business continues to decline due to Princess Ming Yue’s schemes, her brother becomes desperate to help her. Jiang Si live her worst nightmare when she realizes her brother has been tricked by Ming Yue and he is beaten, tortured, and then dumped in the water. Out of anger, she does the unthinkable to get revenge.

14.o: Feeling pressure from the families whose sons died in the fire, the Royal Princess tries to use Chong Yi as the scapegoat, but he shifts the blame to Jiang Zhan. During the court hearing, Jiang Si puts pressure on Chong Yi so that he’ll tell the truth that Ming Yue is to blame for Jiang Zhan’s death. A ghost appears, scaring Chong Yi into telling the whole truth.

15.o: Due to his near-death experience, Jiang Zhan decides to pursue martial arts to become a highly respected guard. He trains hard, but is given a decree to the position by the Emperor, hoping to mollify his pursuit of justice against Ming Yue. Chong Yi and Ming Yue are punished, and Ming Yue is banished to Lingshui to reflect. Jiang Si, Jing Zhan, Chu Chu, and Yu Jin decide to go to Lingshui for other purposes.

16.o: During their journey to Lingshui, Jiang Zhan and Chu Chu begin building their affection towards one another. They all stop at an inn where Jiang Si suddenly becomes sick. The mother and daughter at the inn act strangely and suspiciously. They meet Jiang Zhan’s martial arts teacher, Master Qin and learn of his story.

17.o: Madam Zhu is fed up with Jiang Yi’s inability to have a son. Jiang Si encounters her sister at the temple praying and notices Jiang Yi is being mistreated by Madam Zhu. One suspicious incident follows another, and Jiang Si is determined to not only stay to protect her sister but also find out who is behind the schemes against her.

18.o: The new maid Jiang Yi helped is now working against her. An elaborate trap is set to paint Jiang Yi as indecent, committing an affair. Jiang Si and Yu Jin help her find the actors in the scheme, but they can’t find evidence on who is the mastermind. Despite their suspicions, Jiang Si convinces her sister to stand up for herself.

19.o: Jiang Si and Yu Jin expose the true mastermind behind the attempts to hurt Jiang Yi. Fed up, Jiang Yi asks for a divorce and moves back to the family in Ling’an.

20.o: Jiang Si decides to move forward with her feelings for Yu Jin after learning from her sister that the journey with someone you love is worthwhile, even if the ending is not a good one. Not wanting to be outdone by Jiang Zhan’s military accomplishments, Madam Xiao proposes a betrothal between Jiang Qiao and the son of Lingbei’s governor, who is a military official with a chronic illness.

21.o: Things go awry when Jiang Si’s invitation to meet with Yu Jin is intercepted by the Nightingale sect, and Long Dan mistakes the recipient of the letter to be the Nightingale sect. Jiang Qiao makes a desperate plan to get away from her forced betrothal to the Lingbei governor’s son. Jiang Si and Yu Jin discover the Nightingale’s plan to assassinate the Emperor.

22.o: Yu Jin and Zhen Heng interrogate the Minister of Rights for clues as to how the Nightingale sect plans to assassinate the Emperor. Though they were able to get some information, Jiang Si realizes that they may have made a miscalculation and hopes that Yu Jin can ward off any unexpected threats to the Emperor.

23.o: After realizing his son saved his life, the Emperor takes great pains to repair their relationship. Though he tries to smooth things over between Yu Jin and his mother, their relationship remains strained. Further investigation of the poisoned Nightingale spy leads Yu Jin to Jiang Si, who reveals the truth about her plans.

24.o: Zhen Heng meets Princess Fu Qing, who suffers from an eye disease. Ming Yue continues to pester Yu Jin, who keeps rebuffing her affections. Jiang Si discovers Yu Jin’s true identity and is upset he’s been lying to her all this time. Prince Qi invites Yu Jin for a welcome banquet, and the Crown Prince arrives uninvited to make trouble.

25.o: The Emperor punishes the brawling princes and uses that opportunity to confer Yu Jin as the Prince of Yan. Discovering that Yu Jin and Jiang Si have mutual affections, Jiang Si’s father gets to the bottom of Yu Jin’s family background. Jiang Si has reservations about her future with Yu Jin.

26.o: Concerned that Jiang Si will be embroiled in the dangers of imperial politics, Jiang Si’s father forbids Yu Jin from marrying her. Although she does not like the thought of Yu Jin being a prince, Jiang Si allows herself to continue her affections for him. Yu Jin’s mother holds a floral banquet for him and his 6th brother to search for their princess consorts.

27.o: During the floral banquet, the Royal Princess schemes against Jiang Si. Despite his mother’s objections, Yu Jin makes it clear to everyone present at the banquet that his one and only true love is Jiang Si. The Emperor issues a marriage decree for Yu Jin. Madam Xiao begins to fear that the main branch of the family will completely outshine her branch.

28.o: Fearing for his daughter’s safety, Jiang Si’s father is adamant about stopping the marriage decree despite Jiang Si’s willingness to marry Yu Jin. Jiang Si suddenly falls ill, and her symptoms match those of her mother’s before she passed away. All summoned physicians could not find anything wrong despite her quick decline in health.

29.o: Jiang Si determines that Madam Xiao tried to kill her and her mother. Yu Jin tries to help her find out the real mastermind behind Madam Xiao. Jiang Su’s father knew the mastermind behind Madam Xiao all along, but kept it hidden to protect his children. The truth behind what led to Jiang Si’s mother’s death is revealed.

30.o: Fearing for his children’s safety, Jiang An Cheng forces them to promise not to pursue vengeance against the Royal Princess, but Jiang Si won’t agree. Yu Jin discovers the truth about the true astronomical observation on the day of his birth. Jiang Si enters the palace to get more information about the Princess Royal, but is given a hard time by Yu Jin’s mother.

31.o: Jiang Si and Yu Jin visit the Empress and meet Princess Fu Qing. Jiang Si realizes the cause of Fu Qing’s eye disease and requests to stay for 3 days. She and Yu Jin try to isolate the Nanwu spy that the Princess Royal planted in the Empress’ palace.

32.o: Princess Fu Qing regains her sight and reveals to Jiang Si what she had seen the Princess Royal do, which she has been keeping secret. She meets Zhen Heng on her first foray outside of the palace. Just as Jiang Si and Yu Jin begin focusing on their upcoming wedding, the Princess Royal uses her influence to convince the Emperor to issue another marriage decree.

33.o: Yu Jin goes against the Emperor’s marriage decree to have him marry both Jiang Si and Ming Yue. He goes on a hunger strike, but the Emperor is not moved. Jiang Si agrees to the double marriage so that Yu Jin doesn’t die from starvation. Jiang Yi’s husband, Zhu Zi Yu, suddenly appears, but looks to be in a bad state.

34.o: Despite her pleas to the Royal Princess to save her from the marriage to Zhu Zi Yu, Ming Yue has no other choice but to comply. Zhu Zi Yu gives Ming Yu the best wedding surprise ever. Yu Jin and Jiang Si prepare for the Princess Royal’s vengeance.

35.o: Nightingale summons Jiang Si back to Nanwu. After being a step too late in realizing the Princess Royal’s targets, Jiang Si breaks ties with her family. The Princess Royal finds out about the Nanwu Saintess symbol and sets her sights on Jiang Si, vowing to kill all who hurt Ming Yue.

36.o: The princes switch sides as Jiang Si and Yu Jin expose the Royal Princess’s underhanded schemes, while the Royal Princess begins her attack on Jiang Si with full force. As Jiang Si’s Nanwu Saintess status is revealed to the Emperor, Nanwu forces gather at the border to wage war on Great Zhou.

37.o: The Royal Princess puts pressure on her minions to find “evidence” of Jiang Si colluding with Nanwu, but the plan backfires. One by one, the people Jiang Si has helped are pleading with the Emperor and exposing the Royal Princess’s dirty deeds over the years. As the Emperor wavers in punishing Jiang Si, the Royal Princess decides to take matters into her own hands.

38.o: The Royal Princess shows her true colors to the Emperor, making an unexpected power play in becoming the Regent. The princes choose sides, resulting in dire consequences. Jiang Si heads south to negotiate with Nanwu while Yu Jin returns to the Red Plume Cavalry.

39.o: Jiang Si strikes a deal with the Nanwu people by using the memories of her previous life to tell them about the future. Yu Jin and General Cui make plans to infiltrate the palace, but they require the help of the 4th prince, whose alliance to the Emperor or the Princess Royal remains unknown.

40.o: To prepare for long-term success in Nanwu, Jiang Si stays there, hoping to teach the Nanwu people other ways to live besides warfare. Yu Jin stays in the capital waiting for her, while Jiang Zhan and Chun Chun figure out their next steps.
